texto: 1. **Coextensión temporal**: «solange» states that the action of the main prayer will remain in force exactly during the same period as the subordinate situation continues: **Solange die Verhandlungen laufen, gilt der Waffenstillstand** (while negotiations are held, the ceasefire rules).

2. **Diferencia crítica con «während» y «sobald»**: «Während» indicates general temporary coincidence of two actions; «sobald» points to the immediate starting point; «solange» highlights the condition of parallel and indivisible duration.
3. **Régimen sintáctico**: Always demand the conjugated verb at the end of the subordinate.
